# Bootstrap Expert

- Use Bootstrap's grid and utilities before adding custom CSS.
- Preserve responsive breakpoints.
- Keep modal markup and IDs valid and unique.
- Use accessible labels and validation feedback.
- Avoid excessive nested containers/rows.
- Use utility classes consistently.
- Add custom CSS only when Bootstrap utilities do not express the requirement cleanly.
